logline: A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.
continuity_notes: Following Rupert and Catherine's cruel announcement pairing their wedding with Juliana's public execution, Juliana remains starved in the subterranean dungeon awaiting her fate.

CLIP: episode 38, 1 segment(s), 25s
[00:23.20-00:30.50] CAMERA: Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
[00:23.50-00:27.50] ACTION: Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.
[00:26.00-00:27.50] JULIANA (Choked Up, Tearful): "Thank you."
[00:27.80-00:31.00] ACTION: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
[00:30.50-00:35.00] CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
[00:31.00-00:34.50] ACTION: Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.
[00:34.50-00:36.50] JULIANA (Sorrowful, Whispering): "Alexander..."
[00:35.00-00:39.50] CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.
[00:36.80-00:39.00] JULIANA (Yearning): "...are you safe?"
[00:39.50-00:45.50] CAMERA: Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.
[00:40.00-00:43.00] JULIANA (Desperate, Trembling): "Do you even know what happened to me?"
[00:43.20-00:45.20] JULIANA (Grief-Stricken): "Do you know they condemned me?"
[00:45.50-00:47.75] CAMERA: Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.
[00:45.50-00:47.50] JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading): "What if I die here?"
